# @smthrs/agent

> The Smithers agent: the production agent loop composed on the durable engine, plus the two adapters that run it, AgentSession for control-plane runs and AgentAction for typed workflow steps

- [@smthrs/agent documentation](https://agent.smithers.sh/): Package documentation.
- [Smithers documentation](https://smithers.sh/llms.txt): Main documentation index.
